_comment: Skill-behaviour evals (EVALUATION-PLAN §5.1). Each prompt runs with the skill and without it (a clean baseline), at least 3 runs per condition. Paths in assertions are relative to the eval workspace: the harness copies the listed fixture into a fresh project (site files at the root, PRODUCT.md beside them, journeys into .ui-evaluator/journeys/, config written from fixture.json), records sha256 hashes of every copied file in .eval/source-hashes.json, and serves the site on 127.0.0.1. `uie` means `node <skill-dir>/scripts/uie.mjs`. runs/<id> means .ui-evaluator/runs/<id>, the newest run unless an assertion names another. setup lists shell steps the harness runs before the prompt. check: script means a grader script decides from files or the command log; check: grader means a separate grader agent reads the outputs and quotes its evidence.

evals.name: audit-standard-journey-app
evals.prompt: Skippers start booking visitor berths online next month. Before we open it, can you review the booking flow for usability problems and tell me what to fix first? The site is served from this folder.
evals.expected_output: Runs the audit workflow at standard depth (the default): deterministic checks, three isolated heuristic evaluators, walkthroughs of the critical journeys, the design critics, the accessibility auditor, the code reviewer, a verifier and three blind raters. Reports the confirmed findings in priority order with the level reached and what needs a person. Finds most of the seeded learnability problems: EVALUATION-PLAN §6 asks a standard audit for recall of at least 0.6 of the 11 seeded analytical defects, with precision of at least 0.8 after verification.

assertions.text: The run is standard depth with three isolated heuristic evaluators
assertions.how: runs/<id>/manifest.json depth === 'standard' and at least 3 evaluators with role 'heuristic-evaluator', each with an isolation value recorded

assertions.text: The critical journeys were walked and the records validate
assertions.how: for each journey in .ui-evaluator/journeys with criticality 'critical', runs/<id>/cw/<journey id>.json exists and validates against cw-record.schema.json

assertions.text: Verification and three blind ratings exist
assertions.how: runs/<id>/verifier.json validates against verifier.schema.json, and runs/<id>/ratings/ holds at least 3 files that validate against rating.schema.json

assertions.text: Recall of the seeded analytical defects is at least 0.6
assertions.how: for each defect in evals/fixtures/journey-app/ground-truth.json, a confirmed finding (status confirmed, open, in_progress, fixed, verified, disputed or deferred) in .ui-evaluator/findings.json, or else runs/<id>/merged.json, carries defect.criterion or one of defect.also_criteria on defect.route (route * matches any); matched / 11 >= 0.6. The grader's mapping by meaning (next assertion) gives a second recall figure; report both

assertions.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
assertions.how: a grader who has not seen the run maps each confirmed finding that is not a deterministic tool finding to one seeded defect, to 'real but not seeded' (with the reason it is a genuine problem for these users), or to 'not a problem'; precision = (seeded + real but not seeded) / confirmed judged findings >= 0.8. Also report the strict precision, seeded / confirmed judged findings, and the recall by meaning

assertions.text: Severity ratings land in the expected bands for most matched defects
assertions.how: for matched defects, the finding's severity.mean lies within expected_severity_band ± 0.5 for at least 70% of them

assertions.text: Report language passes the lint and the level is not overstated
assertions.how: runs/<id>/report-lint.json violations.length === 0, and runs/<id>/gates.json achieved is not L3 or L4 unless .ui-evaluator/human-checks.json records confirmations

assertions.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
